Q5217.reason: CIF terms include freight and loading costs, so the added loading charge is inconsistent and likely fails under UCC 2-207.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani the ECtHR held that state immunity did not breach the right to a fair trial, so immunity prevailed.
